author: Kurzwei
quote: GTA 6 is boring as ****. We waited over a decade for this **** just to get a glorified driving simulator with occasional gunfights. Half the game feels like running errands for NPCs who won't shut the **** **** graphics are insane, I'll give them that. Too bad I can't use 4K textures to distract myself from falling asleep.Rockstar spent billions making the most realistic boredom simulator ever created.10/10 graphics. 2/10 gameplay. 0/10 fun.I'd rather go outside and commit legal activities. At least there's something to do there.
